items.title: Don't Look. Listen.
items.task: Close your eyes for thirty seconds in the bamboo. What do you hear?

choices.response: It looks like a grove of trunks. Check the family.

items.title: How Fast?
items.task: Guess how much a bamboo culm can grow in a day. Then we check a careful number later.
items.weirdFact: Some bamboos can grow startlingly fast. Species and rates must be checked before live.
items.notes: Confirm species and growth-rate figures before quoting any number.
